verdict.rationale: Segment's Engage docs confirm that computed traits exist on profiles and can be used to build Audiences, which then sync to hundreds of destinations for targeting. There is no evidence of predictive scores such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity; the pricing line about 'AI-powered audiences' is too vague to count as predictive scoring. missing for 10: documented predictive traits (LTV/churn/purchase propensity), detail on how computed traits are defined and calculated, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: You can build Audiences from core **tracking events**, **traits**, and **computed traits**. You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of [Destinations]
You can build an audience from existing events, traits, computed traits, or other Audiences.
